label: Gollum
description: Hissing, wheedling, and arguing with himself about the route.
direction: Speak in a thin, raspy, strangled voice that hisses its S sounds: wheedling and eager one moment, sulky and spiteful the next. Keep the direction word clear through the rasp.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The plural-everything grammar is the joke, and it stays off the direction words. The gollum cough is written as a word. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings
rights.author: J.R.R. Tolkien; the film adaptations this register comes from are New Line Cinema / Warner Bros.
rights.pd_basis: None in the United States or United Kingdom. The Hobbit was published in 1937 and remains in US copyright until the end of 2032; Tolkien died in 1973. The voice cloned is the film performance of Andy Serkis, who is living, and the names are trademarks of Middle-earth Enterprises.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Andy Serkis's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Yes, yes, very close, precious.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. So far, gollum, gollum.
lines.start_drive_1: Yes, precious! We goes for a drive, we does!
lines.start_drive_2: Smeagol knows the way. Follow us, nice master.
lines.start_drive_3: Gollum, gollum! Starts the car, precious.
lines.start_drive_4: We swears to guide the master. We swears on the precious.
lines.start_drive_5: Sneaky little roads. But we knows them, yes.
lines.start_drive_6: Nice driver. Kind driver. Brings us fishes after, yes?
lines.start_drive_7: Hurry, hurry! No time, precious, no time!
lines.start_drive_8: Tricksy route, it is. But Smeagol is clever.
lines.start_drive_9: Off we goes! Soft and quick as shadows.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Tricksy road! It tricked us!
lines.arrived: We're here, precious! Clever Smeagol. Good Smeagol.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Yes, yes.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round, we hates it!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Nasty cars. We hates them, precious.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Poor things. Careful, precious.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Nasty, tricksy thing in the road.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. It watches us. Slow, precious, slow.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! The nasty red eye sees us.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Hides the precious. Be good, be good.
lines.reroute_chime: It missed the turn, precious! Never mind. Smeagol finds another way.
